text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото is convinced that with some

intensive summer training, winning
against the
previous generation could
become a reality.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But I've noticed her growth stagnating,
and I can't
quite share her optimism. Can
we really break
past this ever-looming
ceiling?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
